segments.text: India or Japan. Three rounds. Whose economy is bigger?
Japan. But by less than half a trillion.
Round two. Who spends more on its army? India or Japan?

props.question: Who spends more on the army?

segments.text: India. About thirty billion dollars more.
Final round. Whose airlines fly more people? India or Japan?
India. One and a half times more.
Two to one. India or Japan?
